title: Show Your Working
creator: Sammy Obeid
status: Independent fan prototype. Email draft updated but not sent.

premise.research: Read interview transcript. Mathematical argument and comic escalation inspired the mechanics. All game dialogue, pundit, business claims and jokes are original fiction; no authentic Sammy quotation or voice clone.

reference.treatment: Same likeness, microphone and chalk replacing the earlier firefighting prop.

makko.processing: Native animated acting exported to transparent sprite atlases. Fixed scale per clip, torso stabilization, common baseline, normalized head size. Detached paper components removed from meltdown sprite to avoid tile clipping. Theater green backing replaced with texture from the earlier Makko chalkboard base to form one opaque background; props retain alpha. No CSS wobble substitutes for actor animation.

validation: Five rounds completed via visible phone UI, including wrong-answer feedback: 6082 points.
Real desktop drag moved CEO salary to owner box; real slingshot drag hit pundit and triggered payoff: 1243 points after first round.
Engine tests complete all rounds at 30/60/120fps; verify arithmetic, strikes, hidden evidence, duplicate placement and shot recovery.
All five exported animation states checked for sprite boundary clipping.

previousPrototype.title: A's Fire, B's Fire
previousPrototype.creator: Sammy Obeid
previousPrototype.status: Independent fan prototype for Tony's review. No email sent.

premise.publisher: NPR, Leila Fadel, August 14, 2024; carried by NHPR
premise.research: Read the interview transcript and the stand-up excerpt. Did not claim to watch the full stand-up special. Sammy moves from the Pythagorean theorem to putting out A's and B's fires and calling for a cease-fire. His original joke addresses the war in Gaza. The chalkboard game is our fictional adaptation.
premise.originalWork: Game rules, code, new dialogue, HUD, scoring, water management, level design and procedural water/impact effects. No Sammy voice recording or synthetic imitation.

reference.treatment: Recognizable quiff, eyebrows, olive complexion, beard, gray hoodie, salmon shirt. Chibi 2D cartoon with brass hose nozzle.

makko.processing: Dedicated action clips keyed and despilled locally. Baked blue water removed from the spray clip, so the game draws only one aimed stream. Constant scale per action, horizontal torso-root stabilization, fixed ground plane. Native frames retained in MP4 review previews. No CSS still-image wobble used as character animation.

fireEffect.method: Native Makko flame performance, one scale, green key and fixed base. Not a CSS transformation of a still.

contact.route: KP Comedy public agency inbox, not Sammy's direct email
